text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of her debut race arrived. As for 
Symboli Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list:
...Doesn't look like you're nervous at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. —I have done what needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
All that remains— is to execute my own 
race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a good way, Symboli Kris S maintained 
the exact same calm composure and sharp 
focus as she did during ordinary training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her unshakable composure even on 
the big stage, I am reminded once more 
that her indomitable spirit and 
self-control are her greatest strengths—
choice_data_list:
First of all... let's make sure we finish 
the race safely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The physical toll a real race will take on 
Symboli Kris S's body remains largely 
unknown. For that reason, I chose my words 
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Whether this will serve as the opening 
salvo of the "revolution" or not, I shall 
watch and see.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— The cold touch of the chains of 
causality seeking to bind my soul to this 
land—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Who shall be the bearer? ...I shall 
discern it. With these eyes of mine, 
envied even by the heavens...!
